headlines.summary:

headlines.title: 《国务院关于金融工作情况的报告》全文发布：支持中央汇金公司发挥类平准基金作用 巩固完善资本市场稳市机制
headlines.summary: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议3日上午在北京人民大会堂举行第二次全体会议。会议听取了中国人民银行行长潘功胜受国务院委托作的关于金融工作情况的报告。全国人大网11月5日发布了《国务院关于金融工作情况的报告——2026年11月3日在十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十五次会议上》。报告称，实施好支持资本市场的货币政策工具，支持中央汇金公司发挥类平准基金作用，拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式，巩固完善资本市场稳市机制；维护股票、债券、外汇等金融市场平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: Full text of the State Council Report on Financial Work released: Support Central Huijin Investment Ltd. in playing a stabilization-fund-like role and consolidate and improve the capital market's stability mechanism
headlines.summary_en: The second plenary session of the 25th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee was held on the morning of the 3rd at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. The meeting heard a report on financial work delivered by PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng on behalf of the State Council. The NPC website published on November 5 the "Report of the State Council on Financial Work — Delivered on November 3, 2026 at the 25th Session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee." The report said: implement monetary policy tools that support the capital market well, support Central Huijin Company in playing a quasi-stabilization fund role, broaden medium- and long-term funding sources, channels and market-entry methods, and consolidate and improve the capital market stabilization mechanism; maintain the smooth operation of the stock, bond, foreign exchange and other financial markets.

headlines.title_en: RBA Deputy Governor Hauser: Public trust remains "surprisingly" solid amid the pain of rate hikes
headlines.summary_en: RBA Deputy Governor Hauser said he was surprised that public trust in the central bank remained solid despite its aggressive rate hikes aimed at curbing persistently sticky high inflation. Hauser said: "Over the past 18 months, our overall trust indicator has remained broadly stable, even rising slightly. This is a gratifying outcome during a period of rising interest rates and inflation far above the target range, but frankly, it is also quite unexpected." The RBA this week delivered its fifth rate hike of 2026, raising the cash rate to 4.85%, an 18-year high. The move may further weigh on mortgage holders. Meanwhile, they also face multiple pressures including higher fuel prices, intensifying cost-of-living pressures, rising unemployment and a softening housing market, factors that are keeping consumer confidence in pessimistic territory. headlines.title: 分析师：美国中期选举结果被视为利好债券与股票
headlines.summary: BondBloxx投资管理公司高级投资策略师乔安妮·比安科表示，投资者认为美国中期选举结果对债券和股票市场构成支撑，因为选举结果提高了进一步扩大财政支出的门槛，也增加了政策受到更多制衡的可能性。她指出，尽管如今华盛顿已很难找到真正主张财政紧缩的鹰派人士，但政策环境更加分散，应该会使财政赤字进一步扩大的难度增加，并有望改善财政前景。比安科在一份报告中表示，展望未来，市场关注焦点将重新转向地缘政治局势，以及美国经济能否继续保持稳健。

headlines.title_en: Analyst: US midterm election results seen as positive for bonds and stocks
headlines.summary_en: Joanne Bianco, senior investment strategist at BondBloxx Investment Management, said investors believe the US midterm election results are supportive for bond and stock markets, because the outcome raises the threshold for further fiscal spending expansion and increases the likelihood of more checks and balances on policy. She noted that although it is now difficult to find genuine fiscal-hawk voices in Washington, a more fragmented policy environment should make it harder for the fiscal deficit to expand further and could improve the fiscal outlook. Bianco said in a report that looking ahead, market focus will shift back to geopolitical developments and whether the US economy can remain sound.

headlines.title: 商务部回应欧盟对低价值进口商品叠加征收有关税费
headlines.summary: 欧盟自11月1日起对低价值进口商品征收2欧元手续费，此前已于7月开始征收3欧元关税。商务部新闻发言人黄玲在5日举行的例行新闻发布会上对此表示，中方高度关注欧方有关新规。跨境电商作为国际贸易的新业态、新模式，为全球企业和消费者提供了多元化选择。希望欧方审慎评估相关政策影响，为中欧在电商等领域合作创造有利条件。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce responds to EU stacking levies on low-value imported goods
headlines.summary_en: The EU imposed a €2 fee on low-value imported goods from November 1, after having imposed a €3 tariff starting in July. Ministry of Commerce spokesperson Huang Ling said at a regular press conference on the 5th that China is highly concerned about the EU's new rules. Cross-border e-commerce, as a new business form and model of international trade, provides diversified choices for global companies and consumers. China hopes the EU will carefully assess the impact of the relevant policies and create favorable conditions for China-EU cooperation in e-commerce and other fields. (Xinhua)

headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: STAR 50 surged then pulled back, closing up more than 2%, with the photovoltaic sector rallying across the board. The Hang Seng Index rose 3.1% at midday, and the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 4.8%, with Meituan, Alibaba, Tencent and others surging collectively. South Korea's stock market fell more than 5% intraday, with Goldman Sachs saying the US "blue wave" will have a major impact on AI regulation. The full text of the "State Council Report on Financial Work" was released: support Central Huijin Company in playing a quasi-stabilization fund role, and consolidate and improve the capital market stabilization mechanism. The opening ceremony of the 9th China International Import Expo was held. Zhuhai plans to spend RMB 181 million to take over idle land under Huafa.

headlines.title: 商务部回应扩大自美采购农产品：持开放态度 对等降税落地是前提
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人黄玲在5日举行的例行新闻发布会上回答有关进口美国农产品的提问时表示，中美农产品贸易是双边经贸合作的重要组成部分。扩大两国在农业领域合作，既可以丰富两国民众的餐桌，也能给两国企业和农民提供稳定的经济收入，为双方带来实实在在的好处。中方一直对扩大自美采购农产品持开放态度，但前提是双方达成的“300亿对300亿”对等降税安排落地。希望美方与中方共同努力，通过共同降低关税、减少非关税壁垒、扩大市场准入等方式，为两国农产品贸易创造更多有利条件。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce on expanding purchases of US agricultural products: China is open, but reciprocal tariff cuts are a prerequisite
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson Huang Ling, responding to a question about imports of US agricultural products at a regular press conference on the 5th, said China-US agricultural trade is an important part of bilateral economic and trade cooperation. Expanding cooperation in agriculture between the two countries can both enrich the dining tables of both peoples and provide stable economic income for companies and farmers in both countries, bringing tangible benefits to both sides. China has always been open to expanding purchases of US agricultural products, but the premise is that the mutually agreed "300 billion to 300 billion" reciprocal tariff reduction arrangement is implemented. China hopes the US side will work with China to create more favorable conditions for agricultural trade between the two countries by jointly reducing tariffs, cutting non-tariff barriers and expanding market access. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 王毅会见朝鲜劳动党代表团
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅5日在京会见由朝鲜劳动党中央政治局委员、中央书记、国际部部长金成男率领的朝鲜劳动党代表团。王毅表示，今年6月，习近平总书记成功对朝鲜进行国事访问，为新时期中朝关系发展指明前进方向。中方愿同朝方共同落实两党两国最高领导人重要共识，推动中朝关系持续向深向实向好发展。王毅并介绍了中共二十届五中全会主要情况。金成男表示，朝方愿同中方一道，遵循两党两国最高领导人的意志，为发展朝中友好关系作出不懈努力。 (新华社)

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi meets with delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea
headlines.summary_en: Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Office of the Central Commission for Foreign Affairs, met in Beijing on the 5th with a delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Kim Song-nam, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Secretary of the WPK Central Committee and Director of its International Department. Wang Yi said that in June this year, General Secretary Xi Jinping successfully paid a state visit to the DPRK, charting the course for the development of China-DPRK relations in the new era. China is willing to work with the DPRK to jointly implement the important consensus of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries and push China-DPRK relations to develop continuously in a deeper, more solid and better direction. Wang Yi also briefed on the main points of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee. Kim Song-nam said the DPRK is willing to work with China, following the will of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, to make unremitting efforts to develop DPRK-China friendly relations. (Xinhua)

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: ChiNext Index rallies then pulls back, closing up 0.87%; more than 4,800 stocks in the broader market gain
headlines.summary_en: 1. Overall trend: The market rallied and then pulled back throughout the day, with the three major indices extending their rebound. Stocks rose broadly, with more than 4,800 shares gaining across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets, and turnover today reached 2.14 trillion yuan. By the close, the Shanghai Composite Index was up 0.1%, the Shenzhen Component Index up 1.19%, and the ChiNext Index up 0.87%. 2. Sectors: Solar, precious metals, AI comic drama, and computing power leasing led gains, while coal, oil and gas, banks, and brokerages led declines. 3. Hot themes: The solar sector strengthened across the board, with Yongzhen shares posting a third straight limit-up, and Junda shares, Oujing Technology, Saiwu Technology and others hitting limit-up. Gold stocks extended gains, with Sichuan Gold, Nankuang Group, Shenzhen China A, and Shengda Resources all posting a second straight limit-up. The AI comic drama concept remained active, with Jishi Media, Ciwen Media, Decai shares, Bona Film Group and others hitting limit-up. On the downside, high-dividend sectors such as oil and gas and banks fell, with PetroChina down more than 8%.

headlines.title: 软银集团收购瑞士-瑞典合资企业机器人业务将被中国发改委阻挠？外交部回应
headlines.summary: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。法新社记者提问，据报道，中国已告知日本软银集团（SoftBank），不会批准其收购瑞士-瑞典合资企业ABB旗下的机器人业务。报道称，软银近期获悉该交易将被中国国家发展和改革委员会阻挠。外交部能否确认相关消息？ “这个问题建议向中方主管部门进行询问。”郭嘉昆说。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: Will China's NDRC block SoftBank Group's acquisition of the Swiss-Swedish joint venture's robotics business? Foreign Ministry responds
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun hosted a regular press conference. An AFP reporter asked: according to reports, China has told Japan's SoftBank Group that it will not approve its acquisition of the robotics business under Switzerland-Sweden joint venture ABB. The report said SoftBank recently learned that the deal would be blocked by China's National Development and Reform Commission. Can the Foreign Ministry confirm this? "I suggest you ask the competent Chinese authorities about this question," Guo Jiakun said. (The Paper)
